query.user: I am traveling to Cambridge and excited to see local tourist attractions. I am looking for a museum in the west part of town.

query.user: That would work well for me can I get their entrance fee and postcode as well?

query.user: Yes, I'm also looking for a hotel called the Lovell Lodge. Can you help me find information about this hotel?

function.name: searchAttraction
function.description: To search for attractions based on name, type, and location, with the capability to specify returned fields.

area.description: The location area of the attraction.

return_info.description: A list specifying the fields to be returned. Options can include various attributes of the attractions.

function.name: searchHotel
function.description: To search for hotels based on a set of criteria including rating, type, amenities, location, and price range.

stars.description: The hotel rating based on stars.

parking.description: Availability of parking at the hotel.

internet.description: Availability of internet service at the hotel.

area.description: The location area of the hotel.

priceRange.description: The price range of the hotel.

return_info.description: A list specifying the fields to be returned.

function.name: bookHotel
function.description: To book hotels by providing booking date, hotel name, duration of stay, number of people, and specifying fields to be returned.

name.description: The hotel name for the booking.

stay.description: The number of days to stay at the hotel.

people.description: The number of people for the booking.

return_info.description: Fields to be returned after booking.

function.name: searchTaxi
function.description: Provides a taxi search service, allowing users to find available taxis and get pricing based on specific criteria.

departure.description: The starting point of the journey

destination.description: The end point of the journey

return_info.description: A list of additional details the user wants to get back, with options including 'all', 'phone', 'license_plate', 'type'. If the user does not specify what information is needed, select 'all'; otherwise, fill in the corresponding name.

day.description: The date for which the taxi service is required.

leaveAt.description: The desired departure time (requires either leaveAt or arriveBy)

arriveBy.description: The time by which the user wants to arrive at the destination (requires either leaveAt or arriveBy)

function.name: BookTaxi
function.description: Allows users to book a taxi by providing the necessary details.

license_plate.description: License plate number of the taxi to be booked

return_info.description: A list of details to be returned after booking, options include 'all', 'isSuccess', 'phone', 'type', 'reference'. If the user does not specify what information is needed, select 'all'; otherwise, fill in the corresponding name.
